design_thesis: Music is gameplay feedback. Pressure and Lumen change arrangement density before the player reads the HUD.

lumen_layers.cue: harmonic shimmer plus distant horn response
overbright shimmer and pursuer breath, no more than once per 2 seconds

transition_policy.critical_sfx_priority: damage and telegraph always win over music layers

fallback.no_pcm: FM+PSG only; pressure still changes arrangement density
fallback.low_budget: switch between pre-rendered XGM2 states instead of live layer mixing
fallback.boss: single final_boss track with phase stingers

validation_plan: Pressure layer transitions do not mask damage or telegraph SFX.
Lumen overbright cue is audible but not annoying.
Boss phase stingers align with weakpoint state.
Audio state is logged in runtime metrics before delivery.
